entries.message: the layer's containing block is inside {ancestor}, which clips its overflow, so the layer can be cut off where it overflows it.
entries.fix: Move the layer out of the clipping ancestor (to the body, or into the top layer as a popover).

entries.message: open() was called while the layer is not shown (not in the document, or display: none), so it has no size to place by.
entries.fix: Show the layer first, then call open().

entries.message: the layer's containing block is rotated or skewed, so the layer cannot be placed on its target: a translation and a scale are corrected for, nothing more.
entries.fix: Move the layer out of the rotated ancestor (to the body, or into the top layer as a popover).

entries.message: the target left the document while the layer was open, so the layer was closed: there is nothing left to place it on.
entries.fix: Close the layer before removing its target, or keep the target in the document while it is open.
